instrument: Gold spot price, USD per troy ounce

source.quote: Gold Spot price USD/oz - 3,996.31 ... Data as of 22 October, 2026

notes: This is the spot price quoted by the World Gold Council, sourced from ICE Data Services. It is NOT the LBMA Gold Price benchmark.

The LBMA Gold Price benchmark cannot be reproduced here: LBMA's official page states its historical tables moved to the MyLBMA Portal and that a licence from ICE Benchmark Administration (IBA) is required to view/redistribute the data. Verified at https://www.lbma.org.uk/prices-and-data/lbma-precious-metal-prices
Spot price is a wholesale, unallocated-metal price. A retail ring is priced at spot + fabrication + stones + margin, so melt value is a floor, not a fair retail price.
Per-gram value is computed in the site at request time (price ÷ 31.1034768) and is never stored as a rounded constant.
